tldr: The unresolved program seeks an evaluated leading term and first nonzero refinement, a formula-based frontier construction, and an all-design complete-table-prior converse. Exact finite-game attainment and certification are established as supporting infrastructure. The causal target is the pair of binary active-versus-control finite-population effects, and the loss is the worst-case expected planar area of a realized convex confidence region. Exact-target posterior identities, coarse rate bounds, spectral benchmark enclosures, and quantitative transfer tools support the investigation. No leading coefficient, refinement normalization, or equality with the Gaussian benchmark has been proved. The consumer is prospective joint precision planning and calibration for two-dose binary-endpoint experiments.
gap: Scalar point-estimation refinements and generic confidence-measure theory do not settle the all-design convex-area frontier for an actual two-component finite-population target.
fill: The sharp-frontier question couples evaluated refinement, uniform exact-target dual transfer, total finite honesty and numerical certification in the original unrestricted decision class.
